scope: One existing browser runner/test file only; 18 other fixed sources byte-identical. No fixture/product change.
reviewed: Five explicit journeys; missing/unknown/prototype-name selector rejected at gate before side effects. Same value flows Gate→Init→result.

Parent independently derives exact required ordered groups; matching completed groups/check count/PASS coverage and zero primary/page/cleanup failure are necessary. Zero or partial selection cannot pass.

Full retains original seven group order and assertion bodies. Recovery chain retains material→cross-tab CAS→same-key lost-ACK. Unselected groups are NOT_SELECTED; no catch-and-continue contaminated state.

Each independent attempt owns original new markedDB/fixture data and new context. page-auth first checkpoints a real draft; csrf-offline checkpoints its own expected text; appearance checkpoints and asserts a real saved row, not empty screenshot. BrowserContext alone is not called server isolation.
Timing uses monotonic worker initialization and at most7 group records. UI preparation is included in group elapsed; no measured speed claim before actual browser.
Native supervisor, DB identity and cleanup, total deadlines and original failed-run carry retained. FullJourneyPassed is limited to original seven-group subset, not full feature acceptance.

local.boundary: Actual extracted selection/run callbacks only; deterministic stub clock, no browser/IDB/HTTP/PG/provider. Two source revisions recorded separately.

limitations: No independent new runtime by root; owner actual output/commands/byte counts reviewed.
Type and extracted-function checks do not validate independent UI setup or server lifecycle. Browser still NOT_RUN for this target.
Initialization import failure before try yields no worker timing/result; parent reports missing outcome, not successful setup. Timing numbers are observations, not performance guarantees.
